messages.author: raj
messages.text: SOC2 Type II audit kicks off next week. Evidence collection starting.

messages.author: tara
messages.text: Change: since February we run access reviews monthly, not quarterly — the auditors required it for SOC2.

messages.author: raj
messages.text: All production access requires MFA and goes through the access request workflow in Vanta.

messages.author: tara
messages.text: Security incidents must be reported to the CISO within 24 hours.

messages.author: raj
messages.text: We encrypt customer data at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2+.

messages.author: tara
messages.text: vendor security reviews are required before we sign any data processing agreement

messages.author: raj
messages.text: compliance is just security theater half the time

messages.author: tara
messages.text: should we require hardware keys for everyone? throwing it out there
